links.name: Lu4
Unlock Lv. 1 Opens Lv. 1 doors with a 30% chance. Also opens treasure chests with a 100% chance.
Backstab Lv. 1 Supplements P. Atk. with 1107 Power to strike an enemy's unprotected back. Available when equipped with a dagger or a dual dagger. Over-hit, critical hit and half-kill are possible.
Deadly Blow Lv. 1 Attacks the target's vital points with 1107 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit. Half-kill.
Lethal Blow Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 4348. Half-kill, Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Critical Blow Lv. 1 Attacks the target's vital points with 1832 Power added to P. Atk. Increases the user's Chance of Blow-Skills by 10%. Over-hit. Half-kill.
Escape Shackle Lv. 1 Allows you to escape from a captured state (Physical and Magical root).
Razor Rain Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage on nearby enemies. Power: 500 in PvP, 625 in PvE. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. Shares reuse time with 'Deadly Blow'.
Dash Lv. 1 Speed +40.
Rapid Shot Lv. 1 Atk. Spd. with Bow +8%.
Ultimate Evasion Lv. 1 Evasion +20 Chance to evade P./M. Skills +25% Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +80%.
Focus Chance Lv. 1 Frontal P. Crit. Rate -15% Side P. Crit. Rate +15% Back P. Crit. Rate +30%.
Focus Power Lv. 1 Frontal P. Crit. Damage -15% Side P. Crit. Damage +15% Back P. Crit. Damage +30%.
Mirage Lv. 1 Provides a chance to cancel the target of an attacking enemy.

Exciting Adventure Lv. 1 For party members: Speed +12 Evasion +15 Chance to evade P. Skills +50% Chance to evade M. Skills +25% Chance of Blow-Skills +20%. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Can't be applied more than once every 60 seconds. Effect only works while in a party with the caster. Only one of these effects can be active at a time: 'Exciting Adventure', 'Wind Riding', or 'Ghost Walking'.
Hide Lv. 1 Hides the user. Effect is canceled if any action other than movement is initiated. Damage of any first attack +15% Speed -30%.
Hide Mate Lv. 1 Makes a party member invisible. Any action other than moving removes the effect.
Illusion Immersion Lv. 1 Gives full debuff immunity. Chance to evade P./M. Skills +25%. Effect only works when character's HP is below 60%.
Trick Lv. 1 Reduces an enemy's aggressive tendencies, causing them to cancel their target.
Switch Lv. 1 Confuses an enemy, causing them to cancel their target.
Lure Lv. 1 Quietly lures an enemy.
Bleed Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20%, and inflicts Bleed, causing them to lose 25 HP every second. Inflicts minor damage based on walked distance.
Stun Shot Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 344 Power to fire an arrow that stuns an enemy. Over-hit and target cancel are possible.
Veil Lv. 1 Creates an illusion of nearby monsters.
Bluff Lv. 1 Deceives an enemy into turning his back, losing his urge to attack and becoming stunned. Target cancel is possible.
Sand Bomb Lv. 1 Detonates a sand bomb at nearby enemies, decrease their Accuracy by 6. Has a chance to cancel the target.
Critical Wound Lv. 1 Received P. Crit. Damage +15%.
Throwing Dagger Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 1142. Applies to enemy: Speed -40%.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Fake Death Lv. 1 Plays dead to keep a monster from attacking. Consumes 10 MP per second.
Silent Move Lv. 1 Prevents preemptive attacks from monsters. P. Def. -8% M. Def. -8%.
Relax Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 5. While sitting, 1 MP is consumed per second.
Accuracy Lv. 1 Accuracy +3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Vicious Stance Lv. 1 Increases Critical Damages by 35. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level. Just for a Blow skills.
Focus Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Skill Mastery Rate +10%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Shadow Step Lv. 1 Allows user to stealthily approach an enemy from behind. Target cancel is possible. Applies to user: Atk. Spd. +18% Chance of Blow-Skills +33%. Duration: 3 sec.
Long Shot Lv. 1 Bow's Attack Range +200.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Bow Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 10.3 when using a bow.
Dagger Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 3.6 when use dagger/dual dagger.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +1 Evasion +4 Received P. Crit. Rate -15%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Potential Ability Lv. 1 With Light Armor and Dagger/Dual Dagger: P. Crit. Rate +15% P. Crit. Damage +177.
Critical Chance Lv. 1 Increases Critical Rate by 20%.
Vital Force Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 1.9 when sitting.
Boost Attack Speed Lv. 1 Atk. Spd. +5%.
Quick Step Lv. 1 Speed +7.
Esprit Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 2.5 and MP Recovery Bonus by 1.8 when running.
Acrobatics Lv. 1 Increases the maximum height user can fall without taking damage by 60.
Critical Damage Lv. 1 Increases Critical Damages by 32.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Boost Breath Lv. 1 Increases lung capacity by 180.
Boost Evasion Lv. 1 Increases Evasion by 2.
Acrobatic Move Lv. 1 Increases Evasion by 4 when running.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Critical Bleed Lv. 1 During standard melee attacks, 10% chance to apply Bleed Lv. 1.
Reverse Mana Flow Lv. 1 MP +12% for every PvP kill.
Unlimited Running Lv. 1 With Light Armor and Dagger/Dual Dagger: Increases Upper Limit for Speed to 255.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Sixth Sense Lv. 1 When HP is below 30%, Evasion +15.
Expose Weak Point Lv. 1 When attacked, 5% chance apply to enemy: P. Def. -20% Received P. Crit. Rate +30%. Duration: 15 sec. Reuse time: 30 sec.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Assassination Lv. 1 With Dagger/Dual Dagger: P. Atk. +15 Chance of Blow-Skills +2%.
Evasion Haste Lv. 1 During Evasion, increases your Atk. Spd. by 15%.
Silent Mind Lv. 1 MP Consumption for bow shots -25%.
Cornered Rat Lv. 1 With Light Armor and Dagger/Dual Dagger: Increases Upper Limit for Hit Chance of Blow Skills from 80% to 100%. Speed +7. Effect only works when character's HP is below 50%.
